caseName: Phillips v. Dall. Cnty. Coll. Cmty. Dist.
caseNameFull: Deloris PHILLIPS v. DALLAS COUNTY COLLEGE COMMUNITY DISTRICT

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied, and petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit dismissed. See Rule 39.8.
